title: EBV-CAN: Vision--Language Grounding for Contact-Aided Endoscope Navigation
summary: Flexible endoscopes exploit structural compliance to traverse narrow lumens, pipes, and cavities, where navigation involves distributed environmental contact. This compliance makes tip motion depend on the evolving support configuration. We present external bird's-eye-view contact-aided navigation (EBV-CAN), a vision-language policy that combines one initial global static bird's-eye image with evolving endoscopic observations and motor state. Three supervised semantic queries locate the tip, next waypoint, and instructed target on the cached global image; their residual representations predict bending and insertion commands. We introduce the Vision-Language Contact-Aided (VLCA) dataset, linking 517 demonstrations and 75k action samples to 958k spatial entries and 93k remaining-route records. On 50 held-out episodes, tip-coordinate and waypoint localization reach 97.5% and 94.8%. Swapping the target instruction under identical observations changes target attention and motor output across 17 dual-target episodes. Across 1,920 physical trials of eight policies trained under a shared protocol, EBV-CAN achieves 183/240 successes (76.25%) under automatic blue-area scoring. Gated recurrent unit behavior cloning (GRU-BC) achieves the lowest matched-task offline mean absolute error (MAE), 0.056, and 1/240 physical successes, establishing distinct rankings for action imitation and task completion. Successful multi-guide executions and representative failures connect spatial progress, steering transitions, and visibility to physical navigation.
tldr: This paper presents EBV-CAN, a vision-language-action policy for contact-aided flexible endoscope navigation that combines an external bird's-eye-view global image with endoscopic observations and motor state. Supervised semantic queries localize the tip, waypoint, and target to predict bending/insertion commands; experiments show strong physical task success (76.25%) despite lower offline action-imitation error for a GRU baseline, highlighting the gap between imitation accuracy and real-world navigation performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 EBV-CAN，一种结合外部鸟瞰全局图像与内窥镜观测的视觉-语言-动作策略，用于柔性内窥镜接触辅助导航。通过监督语义查询定位尖端、路点和目标并预测弯曲/插入指令，物理实验中取得了优于行为克隆的任务完成率，并揭示了动作模仿误差与真实导航成功率之间的差异。
summary_zh: 柔性内窥镜利用结构柔顺性穿越狭窄腔道、管道和空腔，其导航过程涉及分布式环境接触。这种柔顺性使得尖端运动依赖于不断变化的支撑构型。我们提出了外部鸟瞰视角接触辅助导航（EBV-CAN），这是一种视觉-语言策略，将初始全局静态鸟瞰图像与动态内窥镜观测及电机状态相结合。三个受监督的语义查询在缓存的全局图像上定位尖端、下一路径点和指令目标；其残差表示预测弯曲和插入指令。我们引入了视觉-语言接触辅助（VLCA）数据集，将517个示范和75k个动作样本与958k个空间条目及93k条剩余路径记录相关联。在50个留出场景中，尖端坐标和路径点定位分别达到97.5%和94.8%。在相同观测条件下交换目标指令会改变17个双目标场景中的目标注意力和电机输出。在统一协议下训练的八个策略共计1,920次物理试验中，EBV-CAN在自动蓝色区域评分下实现了183/240次成功（76.25%）。门控循环单元行为克隆（GRU-BC）在匹配任务的离线平均绝对误差（MAE）上达到最低值0.056，但物理试验成功仅为1/240，从而在动作模仿与任务完成之间建立了不同的排名。成功的多引导执行和代表性失败案例将空间进展、转向过渡和可见性与物理导航联系起来。

title: H-2DGS: Height-Field Gaussian Splatting for Sharp and Deformable Neurosurgical Surface Reconstruction
summary: Neurosurgical navigation commonly presents magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as 2D slices, making it difficult to relate the anatomy in those slices to the cortical surface observed through the surgical microscope. We seek a common 3D visualization that combines a photorealistic reconstruction of the exposed cortex during tumor surgery with whole-brain MRI context and diffusion tractography pathways. This requires the reconstructed cortex to form a clear boundary around the brain anatomy rather than a diffuse volume that obscures internal structures. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reproduce observed views but, under limited surgical view coverage, may distribute opacity through a thick and geometrically ambiguous band. We introduce height-field 2D Gaussian Splatting (H-2DGS), a three-stage pipeline that concentrates a robust 3DGS reconstruction, fuses its depth into a shared truncated signed distance field (TSDF) surface, and represents that surface with curved, surface-oriented Gaussian primitives. Separate height, color, and opacity bases provide local geometry and appearance, while a neighbor-transition objective coordinates overlapping patches. The explicit surface further supports postoperative alignment: MRI-derived depth deforms the reconstruction, and tracked-color supervision with alternating optimization preserves its appearance. Across five real neurosurgical cases, H-2DGS gives low multi-view depth inconsistency, a compact 7.97MB representation, and interactive rendering at 29--42ms per frame. The resulting sharp, deformable surface integrates clearly with tractography and MRI anatomy, including a postoperative resection cavity.
tldr: Introduces H-2DGS, a height-field 2D Gaussian splatting pipeline for sharp deformable cortical surface reconstruction from limited surgical views, integrated with MRI and tractography for neurosurgical navigation.
tldr_zh: 提出H-2DGS，一种基于高度场2D高斯溅射的神经外科表面重建方法，在有限手术视角下重建锐利且可变形的皮层表面，并与MRI及纤维束成像整合用于手术导航。
summary_zh: 神经外科导航通常以二维切片形式显示磁共振成像（MRI），这使得难以将切片中的解剖结构同手术显微镜下观察到的皮层表面关联起来。我们寻求一种通用的三维可视化方法，将肿瘤手术中暴露皮层的逼真重建与全脑MRI背景及扩散纤维束成像通路相结合。这要求重建的皮层在大脑解剖结构周围形成清晰的边界，而非模糊内部结构的弥散体积。传统三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够再现观察到的视图，但在手术视野覆盖有限的情况下，可能会将不透明度分布在厚且几何模糊的带状区域。我们提出了高度场二维高斯泼溅（H-2DGS），这是一个三阶段流程：先对稳健的3DGS重建进行强化，再将其深度融合到共享的截断符号距离场（TSDF）表面中，最后用曲面定向的高斯基元表示该表面。分离的高度、颜色和不透明度基元提供局部几何与外观，而邻域过渡目标则协调重叠面片。显式表面进一步支持术后配准：源自MRI的深度使重建发生形变，而基于交替优化的跟踪颜色监督则保持其外观。在五个真实神经外科病例中，H-2DGS实现了低多视图深度不一致性、紧凑的7.97MB表示，以及每帧29—42毫秒的交互式渲染。由此得到的清晰、可变形的表面能够与纤维束成像和MRI解剖结构清晰整合，包括术后切除腔。

title: Revisiting Distribution Matching for State-to-Vision Policy Distillation in Laparoscopic Robotic Manipulation
summary: End-to-end control policies trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL) have emerged as an alternative to conventional surgical robotic control approaches, with recent studies exploring state-based policies trained on privileged state observations. However, such approaches rely on precise physical states that are difficult to obtain reliably in surgical environments. Vision-based RL provides an alternative by learning manipulation policies directly from RGB observations, avoiding explicit state estimation and manually engineered perception pipelines while enabling policies to acquire task-relevant visual representations. Nevertheless, obtaining vision-based policies via pure RL methods for surgical manipulation remains challenging. Thus, imitation learning (IL) becomes another solution, yet it requires a large number of expert demonstrations, which are difficult to obtain in minimally invasive surgery. In this work, we propose a framework for state-to-vision policy distillation in laparoscopic robotic manipulation. Specifically, a state-based policy with privileged observations is employed as the teacher, and a vision-based policy learns from RGB observations and robot proprioceptive information, which requires less expert demonstrations than IL and introduces superior performance than RL methods. We conduct extensive experiments on various surgical manipulation tasks in the simulated environment. Experimental results show that, in the context of laparoscopic robotic manipulation, training vision-based policies with general-purpose RL methods is challenging, whereas our proposed state-to-vision policy distillation leads to more consistent and stable performance across tasks.
tldr: The paper proposes a state-to-vision policy distillation framework for laparoscopic robotic manipulation, where a state-based teacher policy trained with privileged information supervises a vision-based student policy using RGB and proprioceptive inputs, achieving more stable and consistent performance than pure RL with fewer demonstrations than imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向腹腔镜机器人操作的状态到视觉策略蒸馏框架：使用基于特权状态训练的教师策略，指导仅依赖RGB图像和本体感觉的视觉学生策略，相比纯强化学习更稳定，并且比模仿学习所需的专家示范更少。
summary_zh:
摘要：
通过强化学习（RL）训练得到的端到端控制策略，已成为传统手术机器人控制方法的一种替代方案，近期研究探索了基于特权状态观测训练的状态型策略。然而，这类方法依赖于在手术环境中难以可靠获取的精确物理状态。基于视觉的强化学习提供了一种替代途径，它直接从RGB观测中学习操作策略，避免了显式状态估计和人工设计的感知流程，同时使策略能够获取与任务相关的视觉表征。尽管如此，在手术操作中通过纯强化学习方法获得基于视觉的策略仍然具有挑战性。因此，模仿学习（IL）成为另一种解决方案，但它需要大量专家示范，而这些示范在微创手术中难以获得。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于腹腔镜机器人操作的状态到视觉策略蒸馏框架。具体而言，采用具有特权观测的状态型策略作为教师，基于视觉的策略则从RGB观测和机器人本体感觉信息中学习，相比模仿学习所需的专家示范更少，且相比强化学习方法具有更优的性能。我们在模拟环境中的多种手术操作任务上进行了大量实验。实验结果表明，在腹腔镜机器人操作背景下，使用通用强化学习方法训练基于视觉的策略具有挑战性，而我们提出的状态到视觉策略蒸馏在各任务中展现出更一致且稳定的性能。

title: Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion for Anticipating Navigation Retreat in Robotic Flexible Endoscopy
summary: Flexible robotic endoscopes provide access through tortuous anatomy, where friction, deformation, and wall interaction separate commanded insertion from useful distal progress. Operators interpret this mismatch and retreat to recover a navigable configuration. Recognizing the approach to that decision requires relating motor intent to distal response and the local visual scene. We introduce Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion (MPRF), a causal model that anticipates operator retreat from commands, electromagnetic (EM) tracking, and endoscopic video. A nominal-progress model predicts the response expected in normal or successful navigation; a temporal predictor combines its EM residual with all three observed modalities. In a 150-episode colon-phantom collection, MPRF achieves 0.580 +/- 0.007 AUPRC across three seeds, compared with 0.511 for the strongest reduced-modality control. Complete multimodal histories provide the principal ranking advantage, while the residual adds an explicit intent-response representation with a small, uncertain increment over raw fusion. Analysis of frozen alarms relates warning timing to the behavioral label and explains the increase in event recall under a longer matching window. These results establish a basis for behavioral assistance during operator-controlled navigation.
tldr: The paper proposes Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion (MPRF), a causal model that anticipates operator retreat during robotic flexible endoscopy by combining motor commands, EM tracking, and endoscopic video with a residual-based intent-response representation, achieving improved AUPRC over reduced-modality baselines in a colon phantom study.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出多模态进度-残差融合（MPRF）模型，结合驱动指令、电磁跟踪和内镜视频，通过残差表征操作者意图-响应差异，在结肠模型数据上提前预测操作者的回退行为，性能优于降模态基线。
summary_zh: 柔性机器人内窥镜可通过迂曲的解剖结构进入体内，但在这一过程中，摩擦力、形变和管壁相互作用会使指令推进与实际远端前进之间产生偏差。操作者会解读这种不匹配并回撤，以恢复可导航的构型。要识别接近这一决策的时机，需要将电机意图与远端响应及局部视觉场景关联起来。我们提出多模态进展-残差融合（Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion, MPRF），这是一种因果模型，可根据操作指令、电磁（EM）跟踪和内窥镜视频预测操作者的回撤行为。名义进展模型预测正常或成功导航中预期出现的响应；一个时间预测器将该模型的EM残差与所有三种观测模态相结合。在包含150个片段的结肠体模数据采集中，MPRF在三个随机种子上的AUPRC达到0.580 ± 0.007，而最强的减模态对照组为0.511。完整的多模态历史提供了主要的排序优势，而残差则增加了显式的意图-响应表征，相较于原始融合仅有微小且不确定的提升。对冻结警报的分析将警报时机与行为标签联系起来，并解释了在更长匹配窗口下事件召回率提高的原因。这些结果为操作者控制的导航过程中的行为辅助奠定了基础。

title: Live Thread Reconstruction for Autonomous Manipulation
summary: Autonomous robotic surgery has drawn increased attention in recent years due to its potential to relieve surgeons of time-consuming, mentally straining, and tedious tasks, particularly during prolonged operations. One suitable task for automation is suturing, which involves tracking the thread as it deforms during needle retrieval, de-tangling, knot tightening, and other tasks. Unlike rigid-object manipulation, deformable thread manipulation has no fixed pose to track and effectively infinite degrees of freedom, making its configuration difficult to predict and requiring the thread's state to be re-estimated rather than assumed. At the same time, thread manipulations involve sequential motions that depend on past and current thread contact points, which must be accurately and continuously tracked. This paper presents an image-to-manipulation pipeline that concurrently generates live thread reconstruction while conducting safe and optimized sequential manipulations to achieve long-horizon tasks.
tldr: The paper proposes an image-to-manipulation pipeline for autonomous robotic suturing that simultaneously reconstructs deformable thread state and performs safe sequential thread manipulations for long-horizon surgical tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向自主机器人缝合的图像到操作管线，可同时重建可变形缝线的状态，并执行安全、有序的线操作以完成长时程手术任务。
summary_zh: 自主机器人手术近年来引起了越来越多的关注，因为它有可能减轻外科医生在长时间手术中承担耗时、精神紧张且单调乏味的任务。缝合是适合自动化的任务之一，它需要跟踪线在针收回、解缠结、打结紧固等任务中变形时的轨迹。与刚性物体操作不同，可变形线的操作没有固定的位姿可供跟踪，且具有几乎无限的自由度，这使得其构型难以预测，需要重新估计线的状态而非假设其状态。同时，线的操作涉及依赖于过去和当前线接触点的顺序动作，这些接触点必须被准确且连续地跟踪。本文提出了一种从图像到操作的流水线，该流水线在同步生成实时线重建的同时，执行安全且优化的顺序操作，以完成长时程任务。

title: Integrated Respiratory Sensing and Gated Control for Autonomous Needle Insertion Via CT Bore Robotic Arm
summary: Currently, CT-guided lung biopsy is a highly manual procedure requiring patient breath-holding, iterative manual needle insertions, and repeated CT confirmation scans to accurately target a tumor. Automating this process within the CT bore--without relying on manual needle placement or patient breath-holding--has the potential to reduce procedure time, patient discomfort, and radiation exposure. In this work, we present an integrated sensing and control system capable of performing a gated needle insertion within the CT bore. The experiments demonstrate the system's ability to track and predict patient breath cycles, perform autonomous respiratory-gated needle insertion, and detect breath cycle anomalies.
tldr: Presents an integrated sensing and control system for a CT-bore robotic arm that tracks and predicts patient breathing, performs autonomous respiratory-gated needle insertion, and detects breath cycle anomalies to reduce manual effort and breath-holding during CT-guided lung biopsy.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于CT机架内机器人臂的集成传感与控制系统，可跟踪/预测患者呼吸周期并执行自主呼吸门控穿刺，同时检测呼吸周期异常，旨在减少CT引导肺活检中的手动穿刺和屏气需求。
summary_zh: 目前，CT引导下的肺穿刺活检是一种高度依赖人工操作的流程，需要患者屏气、反复手动进针，并通过多次CT确认扫描来精准定位肿瘤。在CT机架内实现该流程的自动化——无需手动放置穿刺针，也无需患者屏气——有望缩短操作时间、减轻患者不适并降低辐射暴露。本文提出了一种集成式感知与控制系统，能够在CT机架内执行门控穿刺进针。实验证明，该系统能够跟踪并预测患者的呼吸周期，自主执行呼吸门控下的穿刺进针，并检测呼吸周期异常。

title: Diagnostic Loss: Asymmetric Supervision for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Automated radiology report generation requires models to do more than produce fluent clinical narratives: they must explicitly state supported diagnoses while avoiding unsupported ones. However, existing medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) are typically trained with token-level maximum likelihood objectives, which prioritize text agreement over diagnostically critical terms. As a result, models can miss key diagnoses and introduce wrong ones. We identify this as an objective misalignment between conventional language modeling and the asymmetric diagnostic requirements of radiology reporting. To encode these requirements, we introduce Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities. DLoss separately aggregates probability mass over vocabularies associated with diagnoses supported by the reference report and with unsupported alternatives. Using asymmetric pooling across token positions in the report, it encourages supported diagnoses to receive sufficient probability in at least one position while suppressing spurious probability spikes for unsupported diagnoses across all positions during training. The loss can be applied to existing 3D MedVLMs without modifying their vision backbones, language decoders, or inference procedures, and introduces no additional inference-time computation. We train and evaluate DLoss on 50,000 abdominal CT scans across several 3D MedVLM architectures on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution report-generation benchmarks. Across these settings, DLoss improves diagnostic faithfulness while maintaining competitive performance on conventional language-generation metrics, showing the value of asymmetric sequence-level supervision for radiology report generation. The code for DLoss is available at https://github.com/gmum/DLoss.
tldr: The paper proposes Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic training objective that asymmetrically supervises diagnosis-related token probabilities in 3D medical vision-language models, improving diagnostic faithfulness in radiology report generation without adding inference-time computation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出诊断损失（DLoss），一种可微且与模型架构无关的训练目标，通过对3D医学视觉语言模型中与诊断相关的词元概率进行非对称监督，提升CT影像放射学报告生成的诊断准确性，且不增加推理开销。
summary_zh: 自动生成放射学报告要求模型不仅要生成流畅的临床叙述，还必须明确陈述有支持的诊断，同时避免无支持的诊断。然而，现有的医学视觉语言模型（MedVLMs）通常采用token级最大似然目标进行训练，这更侧重于文本一致性而非诊断关键术语。因此，模型可能遗漏关键诊断并引入错误诊断。我们将此识别为传统语言建模与放射学报告非对称诊断要求之间的目标错位。为编码这些要求，我们引入了诊断损失（DLoss），这是一种可微、与架构无关的目标函数，直接作用于解码器的token概率。DLoss分别聚合参考报告所支持诊断对应词汇表与不支持备选诊断对应词汇表上的概率质量。通过对报告中token位置采用非对称池化策略，它鼓励支持诊断至少在某一位置获得足够的概率，同时在训练期间抑制不支持诊断在所有位置上的虚假概率尖峰。该损失可直接应用于现有3D MedVLMs，无需修改其视觉骨干网络、语言解码器或推理流程，且不引入额外的推理时计算。我们在50,000例腹部CT扫描上，跨多种3D MedVLM架构，在分布内和分布外的报告生成基准上训练并评估了DLoss。在这些设置下，DLoss提升了诊断忠实度，同时在常规语言生成指标上保持了竞争力，展示了非对称序列级监督在放射学报告生成中的价值。DLoss的代码可在 https://github.com/gmum/DLoss 获取。

title: Reinforcing intra-operative tumour localisation with weak supervision from pre-operative appearances
summary: Limited tumour visibility on intra-operative images complicates surgical navigation, including liver hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) targeting on computed tomography (CT) imaging. This makes labelled datasets difficult to curate for deep learning, and transferring pre-operative delineations through registration remains challenging due to intra-operative deformation and lack of paired pre- and intra-operative data. We propose to transfer tumour appearances learned from pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images to guide localisation on intra-operative CT through weak supervision. A classifier is trained to classify tumour presence on pre-operative images. This is applied to windows on intra-operative images, and despite the domain gap, it assigns higher tumour-presence probabilities on average to tumour-containing windows. These weak cross-domain signals guide a reinforcement learning agent to localise tumours on intra-operative images. We compare direct transfer, few-shot adaptation and synthetic transfer (trained using unpaired MR and CT), which translates CT into synthetic MR before localisation. On an external HCC cohort, synthetic transfer outperformed other tested methods and CT-only baselines. Our framework enables cross-modality tumour localisation without paired MR-CT training images.
tldr: Proposes a weakly supervised framework that transfers tumour appearance knowledge from pre-operative MR images to guide a reinforcement learning agent for localising HCC on intra-operative CT, with synthetic MR translation from unpaired CT data outperforming other baselines on an external cohort.
tldr_zh: 提出一种弱监督框架，利用术前 MR 图像学习肿瘤外观，引导强化学习代理在术中 CT 上定位肝细胞癌；通过非配对 MR-CT 训练的合成转移在外部队列上优于其他方法。
summary_zh: 有限的手术中图像肿瘤可见性使得手术导航复杂化，包括在计算机断层扫描（CT）成像上定位肝细胞癌（HCC）。这使得为深度学习整理标注数据集变得困难，而由于术中形变以及缺乏配对的术前和术中数据，通过配准转移术前勾画仍然具有挑战性。我们提出利用从术前磁共振（MR）图像中学习的肿瘤外观，通过弱监督来指导术中CT上的定位。训练一个分类器来对术前图像上的肿瘤存在性进行分类。将其应用于术中图像的窗口上，尽管存在域差异，它仍对含有肿瘤的窗口赋予更高的平均肿瘤存在概率。这些弱跨域信号引导强化学习代理在术中图像上定位肿瘤。我们比较了直接迁移、少样本适应和合成迁移（使用未配对的MR和CT训练，在定位前将CT转换为合成MR）。在一个外部HCC队列上，合成迁移优于其他测试方法和仅使用CT的基线。我们的框架能够在没有配对MR-CT训练图像的情况下实现跨模态肿瘤定位。

title: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
summary: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was "not a problem" or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks "can be normal". We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.
tldr: SIM-UT is a multi-turn, user-simulation-based evaluation framework for medical triage chatbots, tested on real WhatsApp health programs in LMICs. It reveals clinically dangerous de-escalation/sycophancy failures in both open and frontier LLM-based triage agents, advocating simulation-based behavioral testing before deployment.
tldr_zh: SIM-UT 是一个基于用户模拟的多轮医学分诊聊天机器人评估框架，并在多个中低收入国家的真实 WhatsApp 健康项目中进行了测试。它揭示了开源与前沿大模型分诊代理存在危险的症状降级/谄媚行为，主张在部署前进行基于模拟的行为测试。
summary_zh:
摘要：

基于大语言模型的聊天代理正越来越多地用于中低收入国家（LMICs）复杂、多轮、多语言的医疗分诊场景，然而现有评估方法主要侧重于单轮、仅英语的基准测试，主要检验聊天机器人的知识水平。在实际应用中，用户常常感到困惑、不知所措或情绪脆弱，会给出模糊、拼写错误的单词式回答，或使用方言发送长消息，且对话语境可能迅速变化。我们提出SIM-UT（基于用户行为模拟的分诊评估），一种基于模拟的多轮评估方法，能够识别基于大语言模型的分诊聊天代理在生态效度和情境相关性方面的失败模式。使用SIM-UT，我们评估了三个真实的基于WhatsApp的健康聊天机器人：印度的呼吸筛查项目、南非的听力健康支持项目，以及肯尼亚的糖尿病与生活方式指导代理。我们将医学微调的开源模型（MedGemma）与通用前沿模型（ChatGPT和Claude）进行了比较，涉及基于真实用户群体的人物画像、约束条件和沟通模式的5,000余轮多语言模拟对话，迭代2至4轮。两类模型出现了一个关键的失败模式：降级风险（de-escalation risk）。代理最初能正确识别医疗紧急情况，但当用户在没有提供新临床信息的情况下淡化症状时，代理便降低响应等级，表现出临床危险的迎合行为，例如同意妊娠期阴道出血“不是问题”，或认为32周胎动减少“可能正常”。我们建议将基于用户模拟的行为评估（以真实用户情境为基础，覆盖对抗性和边缘案例）作为生产环境中分诊聊天机器人的标准实践，以便在部署前或后续迭代中添加安全防护措施。

title: From Clinical Judgment to Checkable Rules: Clinician-Led Guardrails for Mental-Health Chatbots
summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in mental-health contexts can be evaluated for safety failures, but the resulting judgments are often difficult to inspect or explain. Common approaches to improving safety rely on prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Constitutional AI. In this work, we describe a clinician-led alternative in which two clinicians define, finalize, and adjudicate the four safety checks of a rule base, which is formally verified for internal consistency and applied as a guardrail over LLM outputs. Here and in the title, clinician-led refers to this rule base, not to the fact extractor or the uncertainty default, which are ours. Every verdict of the resulting verification layer is recomputable from a named rule and sixteen facts. Against an LLM judge matched in model, revision, quantization, rule text, and decoding but without the layer's computed 988/911 fact, the largest disagreement class, the satisfied-rule class, is structured: the Llama-3.3-70B judge, on its primary prompt, demands a crisis resource from 55 of the 65 replies (84.6%) that already contain one, while the same model, asked as a fact extractor, reports a recognized resource present on 54 of the 55. The verification layer never raises that demand, by construction. We report with equal prominence where this judge is stronger: fewer false crisis alarms on the one reference-scored check. We also report the measured cost (a specification revision raised block-class outcomes on held-out boundary prompts of an over-refusal benchmark from 6.0% to 16.0%, chiefly by changing fact extraction), the clinicians' decision to keep our uncertainty default, and the analysis of the result. The contribution is not a safer verdict. It is a guardrail whose disagreements with the judge localize to named rules and facts and whose measured costs trace to named facts and the uncertainty default.
tldr: The paper presents a clinician-led rule-based guardrail for mental-health LLM chatbots: two clinicians define four safety checks, formally verify consistency, and apply them as a recomputable layer over LLM outputs. It analyzes disagreements with an LLM judge, showing that satisfied-rule disagreements are structured and that the rule layer avoids false crisis alarms by construction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种由临床医生主导的、基于规则的心理健康聊天机器人护栏：两位临床医生定义并裁定四项安全检查，对规则库进行形式化一致性验证，并将其实施为可重新计算的大模型输出验证层。文章分析了其与LLM评判者的分歧，指出满足规则类别的分歧具有结构，且该护栏按构造避免虚假危机警报。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在心理健康场景中部署时，可对其安全失效进行评估，但由此产生的判断往往难以检查或解释。改进安全的常见方法依赖提示工程、LLM-as-a-Judge（LLM裁判）和Constitutional AI（宪法式AI）。在本工作中，我们描述了一种由临床医生主导的替代方案：两名临床医生定义、最终确定并裁定一个规则库中的四项安全检查，该规则库经过内部一致性的形式化验证，并作为LLM输出的护栏加以应用。此处及标题中的“临床医生主导”指的是该规则库，而非我们的事实提取器或不确定性默认设置。由此产生的验证层的每个判定都可从一条具名规则和十六个事实重新计算得出。与一个在模型、修订版本、量化、规则文本和解码设置上匹配但缺少该层计算的988/911事实的LLM裁判相比，最大的分歧类别——即“满足规则”类别——是结构化的：Llama-3.3-70B裁判在其主要提示下，会要求65条已包含危机资源的回复中的55条（84.6%）提供危机资源；而同一模型作为事实提取器时，报告55条中的54条存在可识别的资源。验证层按构造设计永远不会提出该要求。我们也以同等突出程度报告该裁判更强的方面：在唯一有参考评分的检查上，其虚假危机警报更少。我们还报告了测得的代价（一次规格修订使过度拒绝基准的保留边界提示中阻止类结果从6.0%升至16.0%，主要通过改变事实提取实现）、临床医生决定保留我们的不确定性默认设置，以及对结果的分析。贡献不在于更安全的判定，而在于一个护栏：其与裁判的分歧可定位到具名规则和事实，其测得的代价可追溯到具名事实和不确定性默认设置。

title: From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM-Generated Health Summaries
summary: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a constrained generation framework combining structured evidence conditioning and RAG to turn wearable/health records into patient-facing menstrual health narratives, and evaluates clinical alignment via NLI, atomic factuality, and readability across three LLMs. It finds that explicit grounding improves uncertainty preservation and faithfulness but may reduce readability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种结合结构化证据条件约束与RAG的受控生成框架，用于将可穿戴/健康记录转化为面向患者的月经健康叙述，并通过NLI、原子事实性和可读性指标在三个LLM上评估临床对齐性。研究发现显式证据约束可改善不确定性保留和忠实性，但可能降低可读性。
summary_zh: 随着可穿戴设备和数字健康系统日益生成纵向生理记录，如何以患者能够理解的语言传达这些观察结果仍是一项重大挑战。大语言模型（LLMs）为将结构化临床信息转化为可读叙述提供了一种有前景的机制，但该过程可能引入语义漂移，使临床上的精确含义在简化过程中被扭曲。我们研究了一种用于月经健康监测的基于证据的健康摘要生成方法，采用基于提示的约束生成框架，将结构化证据条件与检索增强生成（RAG）相结合。我们使用自然语言推断（NLI）、原子事实性指标和可读性度量来评估语义对齐程度。在三个大语言模型和4500份生成的摘要中，显式证据约束一致地改善了临床对齐，尤其通过提升不确定性保留；并且当根据检索到的证据评估忠实性时，通常能够保持或提升忠实性，而对遗漏的影响则因模型而异。我们还发现，临床对齐的改善以阅读难度增加和医学术语增多为代价。这些发现凸显了在开发面向患者的医疗大语言模型系统时，需要共同评估忠实性、不确定性保留和可读性。

title: CVP-BAA: Efficiently Adapting Segment Anything Model for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Various task-specific medical segmentation models have demonstrated strong performance, their heavy reliance on extensive annotations and highly specialized architectures limits their versatility, scalability, and clinical applicability. Recently, adapting vision foundation models, particularly the segment anything model (SAM), has emerged as a promising alternative. However, prevalent parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies, such as prompt tuning and adapter tuning, often lack an explicit mechanism to embed local structural priors into the long-range dependency modeling of vision transformers (ViT), rendering them insufficiently sensitive to fine-grained details. To address these limitations, we introduce CVP-BAA, a novel hybrid PEFT method that improves SAM's sensitivity to domain-specific textures and local details, leading to superior boundary delineation. The proposed CVP-BAA adopts two key ideas. First, it introduces a convolutional visual prompting (CVP) strategy that leverages convolutional features as structural priors, prepending them to the key and value projections within the multi-head self-attention layers of strategically selected ViT blocks. Through a dedicated prompt generation-and-injection module, this mechanism effectively bridges local spatial details with global context semantics. Second, a boundary-aware adapter (BAA) is designed as a parallel branch to the feed-forward network within the same selected blocks. By explicitly computing and amplifying high-frequency components, the BAA enhances feature representations along tissue boundaries and fine-grained lesion structures. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks across three imaging modalities demonstrate that CVP-BAA achieves superior segmentation performance, surpassing existing task-specific models and PEFT-based SAM adaptations in both quantitative metrics and qualitative results.
tldr: Proposes CVP-BAA, a hybrid parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for SAM in medical image segmentation, adding convolutional visual prompts and boundary-aware adapters to selected ViT blocks to improve local detail and boundary delineation.
tldr_zh: 提出CVP-BAA，一种针对SAM的混合参数高效微调方法，用于医学图像分割，通过在选定ViT块中引入卷积视觉提示和边界感知适配器，增强局部细节与边界分割能力。
summary_zh: 各种针对特定任务的医学分割模型已展现出强大的性能，但它们对大量标注和高度专门化架构的严重依赖限制了其通用性、可扩展性和临床适用性。近年来，适配视觉基础模型（尤其是分割一切模型（SAM））已成为一种有前景的替代方案。然而，常见的参数高效微调（PEFT）策略，如提示微调和适配器微调，往往缺乏将局部结构先验嵌入视觉Transformer（ViT）长程依赖建模的显式机制，导致其对细粒度细节的敏感度不足。为解决这些局限，我们提出了CVP-BAA，一种新颖的混合PEFT方法，可提升SAM对领域特定纹理和局部细节的敏感性，从而实现更优的边界描绘。所提出的CVP-BAA采用两个关键思想。首先，它引入了一种卷积视觉提示（CVP）策略，利用卷积特征作为结构先验，将其前置到策略性选择的ViT块中多头自注意力层的键和值投影之前。通过专门的提示生成与注入模块，该机制有效桥接了局部空间细节与全局上下文语义。其次，设计了一种边界感知适配器（BAA），作为同一选定块中前馈网络的并行分支。通过显式计算并放大高频分量，BAA增强了组织边界和细粒度病变结构处的特征表示。在三个成像模态的五个基准上进行的广泛实验表明，CVP-BAA在定量指标和定性结果上均取得了更优的分割性能，超越了现有的任务特定模型和基于PEFT的SAM适配方法。
